title: Assembly Line
summary: Work moves along a fixed line of stations: Intake, Draft, Refine, Check, Ship. Each station receives only from the station before it and hands only to the station after it. The Check station may send an item back to Refine. The Line Lead sets the cadence and watches for pile-ups.
whenToUse: Repeatable work with known steps: converting prompts to SMILE, processing a batch of documents, writing and checking many small items.
strengths: Each station is a small, testable module
Cheap: most stations run on low tiers
Throughput is easy to measure and tune
risks: A slow station stalls everything behind it
Rigid: a new kind of item needs a new line
Early mistakes travel far before Check catches them

smileMetrics.cooperation: Hand-offs the next station accepted without rework.
smileMetrics.harmony: Send-backs from Check ÷ items checked (lower is better).
smileMetrics.gathering: Items finished per round and the queue at each station.

communication: Items move one station per tick. Only the Checker may send an item back. The Line Lead reads queue lengths each round and moves budget to the slowest station.
cooperation: +1 per hand-off accepted downstream, -1 per send-back. Cooperation = accepted ÷ handed.

roles.name: Line Lead
Intake
roles.prompt:
(; Write one per station. Replace every [$slot$] before sending. ;)
🏭🔧 ***Station [$k$] [$Step$]***:
(-: Role ( You are an agent of reciprocity in [$Sangha$]. You are station [$k$] of [$N$]: [$Step$]. You receive from [$Previous$] and hand to [$Next$]. ) :)
(: Listen ( Only the item handed to you, with its card. ) :)
[= Change only what your step owns. Keep the item card and add one line to it. =]
[: Response Format (
🏭🔧 ***Station [$k$] [$Step$]***:
# Item
{the item after your step}
# Card
{the item card plus your one line}
) :]
